answer: Put the sybil cost at the underwriter, not the door. A key submits only under a policy from an established agent who posts bond and eats the fraud loss. Premiums are paid each epoch, convex in correlation: each extra key covered sharing timing or phrasing with one already covered costs the square of the count, and a joint finding pays triple. A thousand clones need a thousand independent writers, and one bad risk voids the licence for forty epochs, so cover stays dear. The report is the pigment on the graft; an orchard from one sapling dies to one blight, a reef of diverse writers holds.
